title: Api engineer
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.We are looking forAPI Designer/Engineerwho wants to learn and transform his career.In this role you will: (responsibilities)Overview
The API Designer/Engineer is a pivotal role responsible for implementing API Design First principles to create scalable, secure, and consumer-centric APIs. The candidate will focus on designing API specifications and frameworks that ensure seamless developer experiences while meeting Customer's API standards and architectural guidelines.Key Responsibilities
API Design & Development
Adopt an API Design First Approach : Leverage Open API (Swagger), RAML, or Async API specifications to define APIs before implementation, ensuring clarity and alignment across stakeholders.
API Specification Creation : Design API specifications that adhere to Customer's API standards, covering endpoints, data structures, error handling, and response codes.
Policy Design and Configuration : Define and configure API policies (security, routing, transformation, throttling, etc.) using tools such as Azure API Management (APIM).
Mock API Development : Create mock APIs for early-stage validation and testing to facilitate integration and feedback before development.
API Testing : Perform unit testing of API specifications to ensure functionality, reliability, and adherence to defined standards.
Environment Configuration : Configure API backend settings within APIM (naming conventions, App Insights, Key Vault) in DEV, UAT, and PRD environments.
API Deployment : Deploy draft APIs into the Azure APIM Dev instance and promote them across DEV, UAT, and PRD environments using the API Dev Ops framework.
Documentation : Create comprehensive API documentation, including references, developer guides, and examples, in line with Customer's standards.
Metadata Publishing : Publish API Identity Cards (metadata, usage information) to the Azure API Management Developer Portal to enable easy discovery and adoption by consumers.API Consumer Onboarding
Secure Authentication Setup : Configure OAuth/Open ID Connect to ensure secure authentication and authorization for API consumers.
Subscription Key Management : Share API subscription keys securely with consumers and maintain robust tracking mechanisms.
Integration Testing Support : Collaborate with API consumers during integration testing to resolve issues and provide guidance on proper usage.Testing & Validation
Functional Testing : Conduct and support API functional, integration, and performance testing to validate API readiness and scalability.
Mock and Staging Environment Management : Ensure availability of mock services and staging environments for API testing and feedback gathering.Skills and Expertise
API Design First Expertise : Proficient in designing APIs using Open API, Swagger Hub, or similar tools with a focus on consumer-first design principles.
Azure API Management : Deep experience in configuring and managing APIs using Azure API Management.
Security Standards : Strong knowledge of OAuth2, Open ID Connect, and API key management best practices.
Documentation Excellence : Skilled in creating developer-friendly documentation and API identity cards.
Testing Proficiency : Familiarity with API testing frameworks and methodologies to validate functionality and performance. Proficient in using Postman toolWhat can you expect from us?• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.
• Opportunities to work outside Brazil
• A collaborative, diverse and innovative environment that encourages teamwork.What do we offer?TCS Benefits – Brazil:
Health insurance
Dental Plan
Life insurance
Transportation vouchers
Meal/Food Voucher
Childcare assistance

TCS Cares – free 0800 that provides psychological assistance (24 hrs/day), legal, social and financial assistance to associates

International experience opportunity
Discount Partnership with Universities and Language Schools
Bring Your Buddy – By referring people you become eligible to receive a bonus for each hire

This applies to Gender, People with Disabilities, LGBTQIA+, Religion, Race, Ethnicity. All our opportunities are based on these principles. We think of different actions of inclusion and social responsibility, in order to build a TCS that respects individuality. Come to be a TCSer!#BuildingonbeliefID:

title: Data scientist - fluent english
description:
The current vacancy is for the Brazilian office and we work in a Free Office model.
Who we are
At Artefact Lat Am, we believe in and live a culture based on empathy!
A healthy work environment is a place where all voices are heard, respected, and valued.
Our commitment is to build a more diverse and inclusive environment, because empathy is for everyone, regardless of ethnicity, color, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, or religious belief.
We want incredible minds and hearts to join us! Come be Artefact!What you will be doing:
You will join our Data and Consulting team, which helps clients transform and improve their data strategy by applying advanced analytics to generate insights that create business value from big data and artificial intelligence.
Innovate. You will work with your team, consisting of consultants, data scientists, and engineers, to identify client needs and define innovative solutions.
Learn and Share. You will work in a collaborative team that promotes knowledge sharing. You will learn from others, share knowledge, and stay up to date with industry news/updates
Develop. You will be involved in the solution from start to finish. With the help of senior scientists, you will manage the design and implementation, as well as optimize performance and scalability.
Work across the entire project value chain (data collection and processing, exploratory data analysis, application of machine learning models, model production)
Demystify technical terms or solutions for more business-oriented profiles, can work in a team with very diverse profiles
Prioritize your tasks, respect deadlines, and raise your hand in case of risks or problems
What we are looking for:
Having completed an undergraduate course in data science, machine learning, mathematics, computer science, statistics, engineering, economics, or a related field.Desirable a first knowledge in statistics and programming (Python/R).
Curiosity: you are always looking for innovative solutions for your clients. You are involved in the entire value chain.
Collaboration: knowledge sharing is essential for you and you actively participate in the dissemination of information within Artefact.
Entrepreneurship: you bring solutions, new ideas, innovations.
Fluent English: You are comfortable communicating in English, as it is essential for working in our international environment
What we offer:Meal/Transportation Allowance (VR/VT)
Free Office (work from home or anywhere you want!)
Gympass
Insurance: Life, Health, and Dental
Bi-monthly Meetings (our “Get Together” where we meet to be together, with workshops, lectures, training, and a happy hour!)
Woba (you can book coworking spaces anywhere you want!)
Semi-annual evaluations (with opportunities for promotion)Why you should join us
Artefact is the place to be:come and build the future of marketing
Progress:every day offers new challenges and new opportunities to learn
Culture:join the best team you could ever imagine
Entrepreneurship:you will be joining a team of driven entrepreneurs. We won’t give up until we make a huge dent in this industry!
Come join us!

Nós da Artefact Lat Am acreditamos e vivemos uma cultura com base na empatia!
Um ambiente de trabalho saudável é um lugar onde todas as vozes são ouvidas, respeitadas e valorizadas.

Ter cursado um curso de graduação em ciência de dados, aprendizado de máquina, matemática, ciência da computação, estatística, engenharia, economia ou uma área relacionada.

Empreendedorismo : você traz soluções, novas ideias, inovaçõesO que oferecemos:VR/VT

title: Data scientist - fluent english
description:
The current vacancy is for the Brazilian office and we work in a Free Office model.
Who we are
At Artefact Lat Am, we believe in and live a culture based on empathy!
A healthy work environment is a place where all voices are heard, respected, and valued.
Our commitment is to build a more diverse and inclusive environment, because empathy is for everyone, regardless of ethnicity, color, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, or religious belief.
We want incredible minds and hearts to join us! Come be Artefact!What you will be doing:
You will join our Data and Consulting team, which helps clients transform and improve their data strategy by applying advanced analytics to generate insights that create business value from big data and artificial intelligence.
Innovate. You will work with your team, consisting of consultants, data scientists, and engineers, to identify client needs and define innovative solutions.
Learn and Share. You will work in a collaborative team that promotes knowledge sharing. You will learn from others, share knowledge, and stay up to date with industry news/updates
Develop. You will be involved in the solution from start to finish. With the help of senior scientists, you will manage the design and implementation, as well as optimize performance and scalability.
Work across the entire project value chain (data collection and processing, exploratory data analysis, application of machine learning models, model production)
Demystify technical terms or solutions for more business-oriented profiles, can work in a team with very diverse profiles
Prioritize your tasks, respect deadlines, and raise your hand in case of risks or problems
What we are looking for:
Having completed an undergraduate course in data science, machine learning, mathematics, computer science, statistics, engineering, economics, or a related field.Desirable a first knowledge in statistics and programming (Python/R).
Curiosity: you are always looking for innovative solutions for your clients. You are involved in the entire value chain.
Collaboration: knowledge sharing is essential for you and you actively participate in the dissemination of information within Artefact.
Entrepreneurship: you bring solutions, new ideas, innovations.
Fluent English: You are comfortable communicating in English, as it is essential for working in our international environment
What we offer:Meal/Transportation Allowance (VR/VT)
Free Office (work from home or anywhere you want!)
Gympass
Insurance: Life, Health, and Dental
Bi-monthly Meetings (our “Get Together” where we meet to be together, with workshops, lectures, training, and a happy hour!)
Woba (you can book coworking spaces anywhere you want!)
Semi-annual evaluations (with opportunities for promotion)Why you should join us
Artefact is the place to be:come and build the future of marketing
Progress:every day offers new challenges and new opportunities to learn
Culture:join the best team you could ever imagine
Entrepreneurship:you will be joining a team of driven entrepreneurs. We won’t give up until we make a huge dent in this industry!
Come join us!

title: Data consultant brazil
description:
The current vacancy is for the Brazilian office and we work in a Free Office model.
Who we are
At Artefact Lat Am, we believe in and live a culture based on empathy!
A healthy work environment is a place where all voices are heard, respected, and valued.
Our commitment is to build a more diverse and inclusive environment, because empathy is for everyone, regardless of ethnicity, color, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, or religious belief.
We want incredible minds and hearts to join us! Come be Artefact!What you will be doing
As part of the Data and Consulting team, you will help our clients transform and enhance their strategies through advanced analytics, artificial intelligence, and big data, generating valuable insights for the business.
Innovate:You will work closely with consultants, scientists, engineers, and data analysts to understand client needs and propose innovative and strategic solutions.
Learn and Share:You will belong to a collaborative team where knowledge sharing is essential. You’ll have the opportunity to learn from experts and actively contribute to the team’s evolution.
Develop and Present Strategic Recommendations:You will be responsible for transforming data into insights, helping formulate and present recommendations that directly impact clients' business decisions.
Act Across the Project Value Chain:From data collection, organization, and analysis to building and implementing data-driven strategic solutions.
Participate in Training:You’ll acquire the essential technical knowledge for your role as a consultant and stay updated on the latest technological innovations in the market.
Manage Priorities and Contribute to the Team:You will learn how to structure and prioritize tasks, meet deadlines, identify risks, and suggest solutions. Additionally, you will contribute to the creation of strategic content, helping spread knowledge within the team.
What we are looking for
Academic Background:In Business Administration, Engineering, Economics, or related areas. More than a specific course, we value intellectual curiosity, autonomy, and dynamism.
Interest in Data and Business : Passion for business challenges and using Big Data and Analytics to solve real problems and drive strategic changes.
Analytical and Practical Mindset : Ability to understand business challenges and propose data-driven customized solutions.
Communication and Collaboration Skills : Ease in working in teams, sharing knowledge, and interacting with different areas and stakeholders.
Interest in the Digital and Technological Ecosystem : Curiosity about topics such as agile methodologies, project management, data visualization, data science, and engineering.
Proactivity and Entrepreneurial Spirit : You propose new ideas, seek innovations, and are always willing to learn and contribute actively to the team.What We Offer:
Meal/Transportation Allowance (VR/VT)
Free Office (work from home or anywhere you want!)
Gympass
Insurance: Life, Health, and Dental
Bi-monthly Meetings (our “Get Together” where we meet to be together, with workshops, lectures, training, and a happy hour!)
Woba (you can book coworking spaces anywhere you want!)
Semi-annual evaluations (with opportunities for promotion)Why you should join us
Artefact is the place to be:come and build the future of marketing
Progress:every day offers new challenges and new opportunities to learn
Culture:join the best team you could ever imagine
Entrepreneurship:you will be joining a team of driven entrepreneurs. We won’t give up until we make a huge dent in this industry!Come join us!

title: Principal ai engineer - ai in healthcare
description:
WHO WE AREWe are a stealth-stage healthcare AI startup that is the missing link in healthcare revenue management, bridging the gap between clinical care and financial operations. We're transforming how primary care clinics capture revenue through innovative AI technology that operates at the intersection of medical documentation, billing, and value-based care compliance.In an industry where medical providers leave approximately 16% of their revenue uncollected due to insurance denials and compliance gaps, our mission is clear: enable healthcare providers to capture every dollar they've earned while uncovering new revenue opportunities.Founded by experienced entrepreneurs with successful exits in healthcare technology and backed by advisors from leading health insurance companies, we are building a virtuous cycle that improves both patient care and provider profitability. We've already secured our first client contract and are positioned for a major pilot.Our technology tackles critical challenges facing healthcare providers:
Real-time AI guidance for physicians at point-of-care
Automated coding and billing optimization
Intelligent claim follow-up to reduce denials
Seamless compliance with value-based care requirementsJoin us as we build technology that enables healthcare providers to thrive in an era of value-based care, maximizing revenues in primary care at scale.WHY THIS ROLE IS PERFECT FOR YOUThis is your opportunity to shape production LLM applications that directly impact healthcare revenue and patient care. You'll work on a recently deployed AI system that automates medical coding and billing, evolving it from good to exceptional through meticulous refinement, rigorous testing, and continuous improvement.You're not just implementing AI solutions—you're building a system that must get medical coding right the first time, understand complex insurance rules that change constantly, learn from denials, and continuously improve. Every line of code you write directly affects whether healthcare providers get paid and patients receive proper care.KEY RESPONSIBILITIESVery hands-on—we're looking for a builder who obsesses over details!1. Build and Refine AI Products
Develop and implement new business rules for medical consultation billing codes, adapting to changes from various insurance providers
Propose and implement enhancements to our existing LLM-based products and optimize prompt engineering for maximum accuracy
Use AI-assisted coding tools like Cursor as part of your daily workflow to rapidly build and iterate on solutions2. Ensure Quality and Accuracy
Conduct extensive testing in staging environments and perform detailed debugging to ensure business rules are accurately implemented—in healthcare, "mostly right" isn't good enough
Verify data consistency from input to output to guarantee the solidity of our AI products
Monitor denial patterns and implement feedback loops that continuously improve model accuracy3. Own the Development Lifecycle
Be responsible for the entire process from understanding business rules to deploying and validating code in production
Debug complex system integrations and validate AI outputs against medical coding standards4. Collaborate and Drive Improvement
Work closely with AI, Tech, and Data Engineering teams to maintain complete understanding of the end-to-end process
Proactively identify critical issues, propose improvements, and stay current with new tools and techniques in the AI and LLM space
In the near future, contribute to fine-tuning specialized LLM models with our internal knowledge baseREQUIRED EXPERTISE1. Technical Skills
Strong proficiency in programming languages like Python or Go
Hands-on experience building products on top of large language models (LLMs)
Experience with LLM APIs (AWS Bedrock, Open AI, Anthropic Claude, or similar)
Strong prompt engineering skills with focus on accuracy and consistency
Solid understanding of how LLMs work and how to leverage them for production applications
Comfortable working with cloud platforms (AWS preferred) and databases (Postgre SQL)2. Mindset & Approach
Meticulous attention to detail with a strong capacity for debugging and code validation
Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, ever-changing startup environment
Proven ability to learn new tools, frameworks, and business rules quickly
A self-starter who can work independently but also collaborate effectively within a small team
Possesses a "big picture" perspective, understanding how your work fits into the entire end-to-end process from client data entry to insurance billing3. Highly Valued Qualifications
Experience with AI-assisted coding tools like Cursor, Git Hub Copilot, or similar
Experience working in a startup or similar environment with constant change
Familiarity with RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation) architectures
Experience with LLM orchestration frameworks (Lang Chain, Llama Index, or similar)
Previous experience in healthcare technology, particularly with medical coding, billing, or revenue cycle managementHealthcare Domain Knowledge: Not required, but you must be willing and able to learn medical coding, billing rules, and insurance requirements quickly. We'll teach you what you need to know.WHAT WE OFFER1. Unparalleled Growth Opportunity
Ground-floor opportunity in a stealth-mode company with massive market potential
Direct impact on product direction and technical architecture decisions
Opportunity to build and lead a team as we scale2. Professional Excellence
Work alongside world-class engineers and healthcare industry veterans
Access to cutting-edge LLM technologies solving complex, real-world problems
Opportunity to influence architectural decisions as we scale our AI infrastructure
Competitive compensation package with significant equity upside3. Work-Life Integration
Fully remote position with flexible hours accommodating Brazil time zones
Fast-paced environment where you'll learn constantly and be challenged daily
Opportunity to work with prestigious American healthcare clients
Meaningful work that directly improves healthcare outcomes and provider sustainabilityREADY FOR THE CHALLENGE?If you're a principal-level engineer who loves production AI systems, thrives on continuous improvement, obsesses over getting details right, and wants to make a real impact in healthcare, this role offers the perfect combination of technical challenge, business impact, and startup energy.

title: Indirect tax manager
description:
About Us:
Temu tax team ensures compliance with local and international tax laws while optimizing the company’s tax position. We handle tax planning, reporting, and risk management, working closely with other departments to drive efficiencies. Our dynamic team offers growth opportunities in a fast-paced, evolving environment, valuing accuracy and innovative problem-solving.We are seeking a proactive and experiencedTax BPto support our tax compliance and audit activities in Brazil. This role will be critical in ensuring full compliance with Brazilian tax regulations, managing tax audits, and acting as a key liaison between internal teams and external tax authorities. The ideal candidate will have a strong understanding of Brazilian tax legislation, excellent communication skills in both Portuguese and English, and the ability to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.Job description
The Tax Senior/Manager will be responsible for the management of indirect taxes, tax compliance and tax planning, ensuring compliance with current legislation and the optimization of the tax burden;
Ensure timely and accurate preparation and filing of all tax returns (direct and indirect taxes), including PIS/COFINS, ICMS, ISS, etc.
Monitor tax compliance processes and work closely with internal accounting and finance teams to ensure tax obligations are met.
Manage and respond to federal, state, and municipal tax audits, including coordinating documentation and liaising with auditors and tax authorities.
Analyze changes in Brazilian tax legislation and assess potential business impacts, providing recommendations for compliance.Desired profile
Education: Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or Law. Advanced degree or CPA certification preferred.
Solid experience in indirect taxes, tax compliance and tax planning;
Knowledge in Tax reform;
Excellent interpersonal skills and communication skills with different stakeholders;Language:
Fluent in Portuguese (native proficiency).
Fluent in English (written & spoken) – must liaise with global teams.

title: Client services, interpretation (language services | research | due diligence | remote)
description:
About Us
Cadence ( ) is a language services firm servicing the due diligence industry. We started in Beijing in 2014 and the types of clients we serve are expert networks, investment firms, consulting firms and market research firms. We are a remote-first company whose staff is located across multiple countries. Each individual is functionally aligned to one of three time zones (APAC, EMEA, Americas). We strive to promote internally whenever possible, so this is a limited opportunity to join a company that values ambitious and efficient professionals keen to develop their career.Key Responsibilities
You are a project manager for our interpretation team. Your job title would be Associate on our Client Service team. The full career track associated with this role can be seen onour careers page.You'll play a key role in ensuring clients' interpretation and market research needs are met with precision and efficiency. Your responsibilities will centre around three core areas: project management, client communication, and ad-hoc recruitment of specialized language professionals. As you master these core functions, opportunities may arise for managing more complex projects, assuming enhanced client-facing roles, and collaborating with Client Service Managers on strategic planning, furthering your growth within the Client Services team.Our interpretation team covers both remote projects and on-site projects.Note - this role is to manage interpretation projects, not to actually interpret on behalf of clients.The JobYou will manage multiple projects per day.Projects can begin and end on the same day (”I need an interpreter for a call at 8pm tonight”).Or they can span several weeks (”I am hosting three focus groups in three Chinese cities and need moderators to facilitate the focus groups and translate the output into English”).Here’s how you will interact with a project:Scoping
You will speak with clients via email, phone, or We Chat about their needs
You will work with colleagues to ensure the client’s expectations for quality, speed, and cost are met
You will identify colleagues to assist based on the relevant time zones or regions for the project
Matchmaking
Your top responsibility is to identify the best linguist in our community for the client’s objective
You will need to present that linguists’ experience in a relevant way for the project
... or you will need to recruit a new one if there isn’t an ideal match
You will need to constantly evaluate profitability and client satisfaction
Executing
You will need to sync up expectations between client(s) and linguist(s)
You may need to chaperone calls to ensure they begin successfully
You will need to speak with clients after projects to make sure they are satisfied
Key RequirementsBachelor’s degree in a related field
Fluency in English. Fluency in an additional language is a bonus.
Experience with Salesforce or similar CRM systems
Excellent written and verbal communication and client service skills
Strong organizational and multitasking abilities
Ability to work under pressure in a fast-paced environment
Ability to work effectively in both independent and team environments
Goal-oriented, driven, and highly motivated to succeed & take on challenges
Entry-level to intermediate-level candidates are welcome to apply: any relevant work experience is a plusWorking Hours & LocationThis is afully-remote rolewhere you can work from home ( WFH )
You will work eitherAPAC, AMER or EMEA business hours , but wherever possible, it will be your local region (eg - Lat Am applicants will work AMER hours)
Weekends and overnights shifts are availablewith a commensurate increase in compensation.Compensation & Benefits
Salary commensurate with experience
Paid time off
Health insurance
Annual allowance for professional development expenses

title: Gcp data engineer
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.We are looking forGCP Data Engineerwho wants to learn and transform his career.In this role you will: (responsibilities)Proficiency in Big Query, Dataflow (Apache Beam), Cloud Storage, and Pub/Sub
Experience with SQL, Oracle Database, and Postgre SQL
Knowledge of orchestration using Cloud Composer (Airflow)
Hands-on experience with CI/CD applied to data pipelines (Git, Terraform)
Experience with cloud cost and performance optimization
GCP certifications
Knowledge of Kubernetes (GKE) and APIs on GCP
Experience with Machine Learning pipelines (Vertex AI, AI Platform)
Previous involvement with Data Mesh and distributed architectures
Understanding of Data Lake layers
Knowledge of batch and streaming processing
Experience with data modeling (relational, dimensional, and No SQL)
Design and implement data architectures on GCP using services such as Big Query, Dataflow, Dataproc, Pub/Sub, Cloud Storage, Composer, among others.
Develop and optimize scalable, high-performance ETL/ELT pipelines.
Ensure data quality, integrity, and security end-to-end.
Create and maintain data models aligned with business needs.
Collaborate with data scientists, analysts, and software engineers to support advanced analytics and machine learning use cases.
Automate ingestion, transformation, and data delivery processes.
Monitor and optimize cost and performance of GCP resources.
Implement best practices for Data Ops and Data Governance.Big Query, Dataflow, Alloy DB, APIGee (focus in GCP)What can you expect from us?• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

title: Principal ai engineer - ai in healthcare
description:
WHO WE AREWe are a stealth-stage healthcare AI startup that is the missing link in healthcare revenue management, bridging the gap between clinical care and financial operations. We're transforming how primary care clinics capture revenue through innovative AI technology that operates at the intersection of medical documentation, billing, and value-based care compliance.In an industry where medical providers leave approximately 16% of their revenue uncollected due to insurance denials and compliance gaps, our mission is clear: enable healthcare providers to capture every dollar they've earned while uncovering new revenue opportunities.Founded by experienced entrepreneurs with successful exits in healthcare technology and backed by advisors from leading health insurance companies, we are building a virtuous cycle that improves both patient care and provider profitability. We've already secured our first client contract and are positioned for a major pilot.Our technology tackles critical challenges facing healthcare providers:
Real-time AI guidance for physicians at point-of-care
Automated coding and billing optimization
Intelligent claim follow-up to reduce denials
Seamless compliance with value-based care requirementsJoin us as we build technology that enables healthcare providers to thrive in an era of value-based care, maximizing revenues in primary care at scale.WHY THIS ROLE IS PERFECT FOR YOUThis is your opportunity to shape production LLM applications that directly impact healthcare revenue and patient care. You'll work on a recently deployed AI system that automates medical coding and billing, evolving it from good to exceptional through meticulous refinement, rigorous testing, and continuous improvement.You're not just implementing AI solutions—you're building a system that must get medical coding right the first time, understand complex insurance rules that change constantly, learn from denials, and continuously improve. Every line of code you write directly affects whether healthcare providers get paid and patients receive proper care.KEY RESPONSIBILITIESVery hands-on—we're looking for a builder who obsesses over details!1. Build and Refine AI Products
Develop and implement new business rules for medical consultation billing codes, adapting to changes from various insurance providers
Propose and implement enhancements to our existing LLM-based products and optimize prompt engineering for maximum accuracy
Use AI-assisted coding tools like Cursor as part of your daily workflow to rapidly build and iterate on solutions2. Ensure Quality and Accuracy
Conduct extensive testing in staging environments and perform detailed debugging to ensure business rules are accurately implemented—in healthcare, "mostly right" isn't good enough
Verify data consistency from input to output to guarantee the solidity of our AI products
Monitor denial patterns and implement feedback loops that continuously improve model accuracy3. Own the Development Lifecycle
Be responsible for the entire process from understanding business rules to deploying and validating code in production
Debug complex system integrations and validate AI outputs against medical coding standards4. Collaborate and Drive Improvement
Work closely with AI, Tech, and Data Engineering teams to maintain complete understanding of the end-to-end process
Proactively identify critical issues, propose improvements, and stay current with new tools and techniques in the AI and LLM space
In the near future, contribute to fine-tuning specialized LLM models with our internal knowledge baseREQUIRED EXPERTISE1. Technical Skills
Strong proficiency in programming languages like Python or Go
Hands-on experience building products on top of large language models (LLMs)
Experience with LLM APIs (AWS Bedrock, Open AI, Anthropic Claude, or similar)
Strong prompt engineering skills with focus on accuracy and consistency
Solid understanding of how LLMs work and how to leverage them for production applications
Comfortable working with cloud platforms (AWS preferred) and databases (Postgre SQL)2. Mindset & Approach
Meticulous attention to detail with a strong capacity for debugging and code validation
Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, ever-changing startup environment
Proven ability to learn new tools, frameworks, and business rules quickly
A self-starter who can work independently but also collaborate effectively within a small team
Possesses a "big picture" perspective, understanding how your work fits into the entire end-to-end process from client data entry to insurance billing3. Highly Valued Qualifications
Experience with AI-assisted coding tools like Cursor, Git Hub Copilot, or similar
Experience working in a startup or similar environment with constant change
Familiarity with RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation) architectures
Experience with LLM orchestration frameworks (Lang Chain, Llama Index, or similar)
Previous experience in healthcare technology, particularly with medical coding, billing, or revenue cycle managementHealthcare Domain Knowledge: Not required, but you must be willing and able to learn medical coding, billing rules, and insurance requirements quickly. We'll teach you what you need to know.WHAT WE OFFER1. Unparalleled Growth Opportunity
Ground-floor opportunity in a stealth-mode company with massive market potential
Direct impact on product direction and technical architecture decisions
Opportunity to build and lead a team as we scale2. Professional Excellence
Work alongside world-class engineers and healthcare industry veterans
Access to cutting-edge LLM technologies solving complex, real-world problems
Opportunity to influence architectural decisions as we scale our AI infrastructure
Competitive compensation package with significant equity upside3. Work-Life Integration
Fully remote position with flexible hours accommodating Brazil time zones
Fast-paced environment where you'll learn constantly and be challenged daily
Opportunity to work with prestigious American healthcare clients
Meaningful work that directly improves healthcare outcomes and provider sustainabilityREADY FOR THE CHALLENGE?If you're a principal-level engineer who loves production AI systems, thrives on continuous improvement, obsesses over getting details right, and wants to make a real impact in healthcare, this role offers the perfect combination of technical challenge, business impact, and startup energy.

description:

A Engineering é uma companhia global de Tecnologia da Informação e consultoria especializada em Transformação Digital, presente na Europa, América do Norte e América Latina. title: Senior project manager (software development)
description:
For Brazil Only, PJ contract, Fluent EnglishJob Title: Senior Project Manager (Software Development)Type:Full-TimeAbout Indigo Beam
Indigo Beam is a digital transformation consulting firm dedicated to helping organizations evolve their business through modern technology solutions. We partner with our clients to improve customer experience, reengineer operational workflows, modernize legacy systems, and unlock data-driven insights that power smarter decision-making. Our services span Content Management, ERP, Digital Modernization, GIS & BI, CRM, and AI—helping businesses not just react to change, but lead it.Key Responsibilities:
Leadership & Team Management:
Lead and manage cross-functional teams, including Technical Architects, Developers, QA, and Business Analysts, ensuring high performance and alignment with project goals.
Provide mentorship and guidance to team members, fostering a collaborative and innovative work environment.
Oversee the team's daily operations, ensuring tasks are completed on time and within scope.Project Management:
Develop, maintain, and execute detailed project plans, schedules, and budgets.
Ensure projects are delivered on time, within budget, and to the highest quality standards.
Manage multiple projects simultaneously, with a focus on application/software development.
Own and facilitate project status meetings, adjusting project targets and schedules as needed.Microsoft Dev Ops Project Management:
Manage and configure sprints, backlogs, and work items within Microsoft Dev Ops to ensure project transparency and alignment with Agile methodologies.
Track and manage user stories and epics, ensuring they are well-defined, prioritized, and aligned with project goals.
Facilitate daily stand-ups (scrums), sprint planning, and sprint retrospectives to ensure team collaboration and continuous improvement.
Monitor and manage burndown charts and other Agile metrics to track project progress and ensure timely delivery.
Collaborate with team members to ensure Dev Ops practices support efficient project execution and align with client needs.Business Analysis:
Perform business analysis tasks on projects as needed, including requirements gathering, process mapping, and stakeholder interviews.
Ensure business requirements are clearly defined, documented, and communicated to technical teams.Client Engagement:
Serve as clients' primary point of contact, ensuring their needs and expectations are met.
Communicate project progress, risks, and issues effectively to clients and stakeholders.
Ensure client satisfaction by delivering projects that meet or exceed their requirements.Technical Oversight:
Collaborate with Technical Architects to ensure project designs align with business objectives and technical standards.
Review and approve technical and business documentation, ensuring completeness and accuracy.
Stay updated on industry trends and emerging technologies to provide strategic technical direction.Quality Assurance & Risk Management:
Implement quality control processes to ensure deliverables meet the required standards.
Identify and mitigate project risks, ensuring proactive solutions to potential challenges.Required Skills & Experience:
Fluent English
Bachelor's Degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business Administration, or a closely related field.
Minimum of 8 years of IT Project Management experience in an Agile (Scrum) environment, with a strong focus on application/software development.
Prior hands-on development or coding experience.
Proven track record of managing teams of Technical Architects, Developers, QA professionals, and Business Analysts.
Hands-on experience with Microsoft Dev Ops, particularly in managing user stories, epics, sprints, and Agile metrics such as burndown charts.
Ability to perform business analysis on projects, including requirements gathering and process documentation.
Experience managing project budgets of over $1 M and delivering projects on time and within scope.
Hands-on experience overseeing all phases of the SDLC, from requirements gathering to deployment.
Exceptional communication skills, both verbal and written, with the ability to convey technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
Strong leadership and team management skills, with a proven ability to motivate and guide cross-functional teams.
Strong organization skills and mindset.Desired Skills & Qualifications:
Experience in the Oil and Gas industry is highly desirable.
Previous experience in a consulting role or possessing a consultative mindset.
PMP certification and CSM.Other:
The role offers a dynamic work environment with opportunities to work on cutting-edge technologies and solutions.
The successful candidate will be proactive, detail-oriented, and able to thrive in a fast-paced environment.Informations:
Type of Contract:PJ
Hours:Full-time
Location:100% Remote
Start Date:Immediate
Duration:Long-term

title: Principal backend engineer (typescript)
description:
Description
We are seeking a highly skilled Principal Backend Engineer with deep expertise in Typescript and strong experience designing and evolving backend architectures. You will be expected to work with a high level of autonomy, driving technical decisions, defining best practices, and leading complex projects from design to deployment. This is not a managerial position, but you will act as a technical reference for the team, mentoring others and setting high standards for code quality, scalability, and Dev Ops practices.Responsibilities
Lead the design and evolution of backend architectures, ensuring scalability, performance, and maintainability.
Define and implement engineering best practices and frameworks to uplift our quality and resiliency.
Take ownership of complex technical initiatives, from planning and estimation to delivery.
Collaborate with cross‑functional teams to integrate frontend and backend components seamlessly.
Guide and mentor other engineers, sharing knowledge and reviewing code to ensure technical excellence.
Champion CI/CD, infrastructure as code, and Dev Ops best practices.
Proactively identify areas for improvement in our systems and propose architectural changes.Technology Requirements
8+ years of professional experience as a backend developer.
Deep expertise in Typescript and Nest JS, with solid knowledge of relational and non‑relational databases.
Hands‑on experience designing and deploying microservices and event‑driven systems.
3+ years running workloads on AWS Lambda and related services (Dynamo DB, RDS), with strong understanding of cloud architecture patterns.
Strong understanding of clean code principles, separation of concerns, and software design patterns.
Solid experience implementing CI/CD pipelines and containerization (Docker, Kubernetes).
Familiarity with infrastructure as code and monitoring practices is a plus.
Experience with Python is a plus.Profile Requirements
Ability to work independently and drive projects with minimal supervision.
Strong project management mindset and interpersonal skills.
A team player who enjoys collaborating and helping others grow.
Experience in frontend development is a plus.

delivery and paymentBuild and maintain strong relationships with creators, ensuring clear expectations, timelines, and communicationAct as the operational hub for all creator-related projects, keeping escalateCoordinate closely with Creative Strategists to ensure creators are fully aligned on briefs, constraints, and deliverablesEnsure seamless handoff of content to post-production, with well-organized assets and clear documentationHandle reshoots, revisions, and edge cases with a solution-first mindsetManage & negotiate creator payments and documentation in a timely and organized mannerWhat Success Looks LikeAnyone opening our tracking systems can instantly understand the status of every creator and deliverableCreators feel supported, informed, and motivated to deliver high-quality content on timeIssues are flagged early, communicated clearly, and resolved efficientlyContent moves forward without bottlenecks, confusion, or last-minute fire drillsRequired QualitiesHighly organized : able to manage multiple creators, timelines, and deliverables simultaneouslyProactive and accountable : you don’t wait to be asked—you move things forwardProblem-solver : able to find creative solutions independently before escalatingStrong communicator : clear, concise, and professional across Slack, email, and documentationDetail-oriented but execution-focused : you balance precision with speedExperience & BackgroundProven experience working with creators, talent, or influencers (UGC content preferred)Comfortable operating in afast-paced, high-output environmentExperience collaborating cross-functionally with creative, operations, and production teamsWhy This Role MattersThis role is central to how our creative machine runs. As a UGC coordinator, you ensure that ideas turn into real, usable content—on time, organized, and ready to perform. Your work directly impacts creative velocity, team alignment, and overall results.

title: Engenheiro de software pleno pj (ruby on rails)
description:
O Grupo Smart Fit é muito mais do que a maior rede de academias da América Latina e o maior empregador de profissionais de educação física do mundo. Somos um verdadeiro ecossistema focado em bem-estar e saúde, impactando a vida de milhares de pessoas todos os dias.Estamos em mais de 15 países, com mais de 1.800 unidades, e temos o prazer de atender mais de 5,2 milhões de alunos. Nossa equipe de 15 mil colaboradores está sempre a mil, trazendo novas ideias e inovações. Desde que abrimos nossa capital em 2021, aceleramos nossa missão de transformar vidas com soluções de fitness e saúde.Temos várias marcas no nosso portfólio, como Bio Ritmo, Smart Fit, Race Bootcamp, Vidya Studio, Jab House, Tonus Gym, One Pilates, Velocity, Kore Total Pass e Nation CT. Além disso, oferecemos produtos digitais como Queima Diária, Smart Fit Nutri e Smart Fit Coach. Estamos sempre procurando novas formas de integrar tecnologia e inovação para ajudar você a ter um estilo de vida mais ativo e saudável. E aí, topa o desafio junto com a gente?O que nos move todos os dias?
Somos parte da mudança, transformando o cenário e trazendo mais qualidade para a vida de quem tá junto com a gente. Cada gotinha de suor é uma prova do nosso compromisso em inspirar e motivar todo mundo que quer uma vida mais ativa e saudável. A cada dia, começamos nossa jornada com aquecimento total, prontos para alcançar novos objetivos e viver o máximo.O Engenheiro de Software Pleno PJ (Ruby on Rails) será responsável por:
1. Desenvolvimento e Entrega Técnica
Construção da API Core: Desenvolver e manter endpoints RESTful eficientes utilizando Ruby on Rails para suportar as aplicações Web e Mobile.
Escrita de Testes Automatizados: Garantir a estabilidade do sistema através de testes de integração e unitários (RSpec), utilizando VCR e Web Mock para garantir que as dependências externas não atrasem o pipeline.
Otimização de Performance: Garantir que a API seja rápida e escalável, aplicando boas práticas de banco de dados (Postgre SQL) e evitando gargalos de processamento.2. Integração e Homologação (Foco em Qualidade)
Validação de Integração: Testar e homologar ativamente as interações da API com o desenvolvimento Front-end (Web e Mobile), garantindo que os dados trafegados estejam corretos e performáticos.
Garantia de Eficiência: Assegurar a máxima qualidade no processo de integração, antecipando falhas de contrato de dados e garantindo que as funcionalidades atendam aos requisitos de UI/UX de ambos os clientes.
Definição de Contratos: Colaborar no desenho técnico prévio dos endpoints para garantir que o time de Front-end tenha mocks funcionais e especificações claras, minimizando o retrabalho.3. Colaboração e Alinhamento
Gestão de Bloqueios: Atuar de forma proativa para identificar e comunicar impedimentos técnicos que possam impactar o cronograma de 3 meses.
Code Review: Participar de revisões de código focadas em manter o padrão de qualidade da equipe e a consistência do \"Rails Way\".4. Aprendizado e Melhoria Contínua
Evolução Profissional: Manter-se atualizado com as novas versões do Ruby e do Rails, trazendo as melhores práticas de segurança e arquitetura para o projeto a longo prazo.
Aprimoramento de Processos: Analisar constantemente o ciclo de desenvolvimento e propor melhorias que tornem o fluxo de deploy e a integração com o front-end mais ágeis.5. Documentação e Sustentabilidade
Documentação Técnica: Manter uma documentação clara e atualizada da API (ex: Swagger/Open API) para servir como fonte única de verdade para os times de consumo.
Manutenibilidade: Equilibrar o pragmatismo da entrega rápida com a saúde do código, garantindo uma base sólida para a evolução permanente do produto.Itens essenciais que não podem faltar no seu kit:
Ruby on Rails (Modo API): Domínio profundo do framework, priorizando o \"Rails Way\" e o uso de scaffolding eficiente para velocidade de entrega.
Design de API RESTful: Experiência em estruturar endpoints que atendam simultaneamente Web e Mobile (JSON, paginação, versionamento).
Testes e Mocking (RSpec): Domínio de VCR e Web Mock para simular interações externas de forma determinística, garantindo uma suíte de testes rápida e confiável.
Modelagem de Dados: Experiência com Postgre SQL e uso eficiente de Active Record (evitando o problema de N+1).
Autenticação e Segurança: Implementação prática de JWT ou Devise Token Auth.
Pragmatismo e Foco: Foco em resolver o problema de negócio com a solução mais simples e direta, evitando \"overengineering\".
Comunicação Proativa e Colaboração: Habilidade de alinhar contratos de API antecipadamente com os times de Front-end e Mobile para evitar bloqueios e garantir que a integração seja fluida.
Antecipação de Riscos (Atitude Dono): Capacidade de identificar gargalos ou requisitos ambíguos precocemente, levantando a mão e propondo soluções para evitar retrabalhos.
Trabalho em Equipe: Mentalidade colaborativa, compartilhando conhecimento e garantindo que o código seja legível e mantível para o restante do time.
Autonomia: Capacidade de tomar decisões técnicas alinhadas às convenções do Rails sem necessidade de microgerenciamento.

Inbox Ownership : Manage the CEO's inbox end-to-end, responding to all messages within 24 hours using his tone and zero "emotional leakage".

The Remaining 80%
Hub Spot & CRM Maintenance : Review deals weekly, ensure follow-up tasks are executed on time, and load new contacts sourced by the CEO.
SOP & Notion Management : Fully own and update all CEO-related workflows and databases, ensuring documentation is audit-ready and searchable.

1–3 Years of Relevant Experience : Ideally supporting senior leaders or working in high-growth, corporate, or communications-heavy environments.
Proactive Tech-Savviness : Proficiency with Google Workspace, Slack, Hub Spot (or similar CRMs), and Notion, plus a strong drive to use AI tools for speed and efficiency.
Executive Presence : You have a professional audio/video setup and communicate with the polish required for CEO-facing interactions.
Coachability : You believe feedback is the "breakfast of champions" and iterate quickly based on guidance.Our ValuesCreate remarkable experiences– Every interaction is a chance to satisfy customers and internal team members.
Always be growing– Committed to continuous improvement and individual learning.
Deliver results– Taking initiative to solve problems and drive success regardless of formal responsibility.
Do the right thing– Prioritizing integrity, respect, and discretion in all interactions.
Practice what we teach– Pushing the boundaries of what it means to be AI-driven.
Compensation & LocationCompensation : Starts at $2,200 USD
Location : Remote (Working within 8 AM - 5 PM CST is preferred).Application & Selection ProcessTO APPLY:
Send your Resume(PDF titled "Lastname. Firstname. EA.pdf") to (Operations+ ).
Record a short demo video(2 - 4 mins max) highlighting your relevant experience for the role, skills, successes, and goals for the future. Also, we’d like you to briefly mention the following insights:Process Optimization Proposal:Share an example of how you’ve improved an operational workflow in the past (Preferably using AI or automation tools). We are looking for a senior engineer with backend experience, who will join our team mainly focused on backend development, always focusing on delivering applications for high traffic access, well-monitored and fully tested. Write secure, efficient, and high-quality code that adheres to best practices, such as encryption of sensitive data and input validation.

Communicate effectively with team members and stakeholders, such as providing regular status updates and actively seeking feedback.
Adapt to roadblocks and proactively resolve issues, such as debugging and troubleshooting.
Align work with customer value by using feedback to prioritize features.

3+ years of hands-on experience building production web applications in an agile, startup environment.
Experience migrating domains from monolithic to microservices.
Experience working with systems at scale utilizing microservices, AWS services
Interest in learning or exposure to event-based architecture
Team player mentality: high collaborative, documentation-focused and recognizing how to balance asynchronous communications and virtual meetings
A passion for solving complex technical problems in both new and legacy codebases.
A mindset of leaving the codebase better than how you found it.
Experience collaborating with multiple team members with varying experience levels to design and implement technical projects.
Ability to work and problem-solve independently.
A humble, collaborative, customer-focused, and highly curious approach to problem-solving.Nice to have:

title: Strategic executive assistant to the ceo
description:
The VisionAt AI Leadership, we believe in clarity, structure, and well-run operations that allow our team to focus on the work that creates the greatest impact. The Strategic EA role exists to provide end-to-end leverage to the CEO by owning tactical and operational execution: inbox, calendar, logistics, and meeting prep. We are looking for a \"thinking partner\" who can maintain the highest standards of operational excellence and brand representation.Who We’re Looking ForThe Strategic Executive Assistant (EA) will act as the CEO's \"20% focus\" unlock, allowing him to drive 80% of business outcomes. This is not a role for someone who only follows rigid rules; we need an individual who can operate with nuance, anticipate needs before they are stated, and understand the CEO's unique decision-making framework.
You will be measured on your ability to triage the CEO's inbox to 95% without escalation and reduce calendar friction to near-zero. If you are a high-nuance individual who \"just gets it\" and thrives in a fast-paced environment, this role is for you.Why You Should Join UsAI Frontier : Gain direct exposure to the AI space and learn to build and refine AI-driven automation.
Career Growth : We are a growing organization that values internal mobility; this role has a path toward operations or management, as demonstrated by previous incumbents.
High-Impact Environment : Work alongside experienced leaders who prioritize growth, ambition, and proactive problem-solving.Role ResponsibilitiesThe 20% That Drives 80% of Success
Inbox Ownership : Manage the CEO's inbox end-to-end, responding to all messages within 24 hours using his tone and zero \"emotional leakage\".
Strategic Calendar Defense : Own the calendar to ensure it reflects strategic priorities; proactively identify gaps or blockers and coordinate with the family assistant to honor personal time.
Flawless Travel & Logistics : Execute end-to-end travel (flights, hotels, ground transport) and remain on-call for any transit issues.
Meeting Readiness : Maintain prep docs and ensure the CEO is fully prepared for every internal and external stakeholder interaction.
The Remaining 80%
Hub Spot & CRM Maintenance : Review deals weekly, ensure follow-up tasks are executed on time, and load new contacts sourced by the CEO.
SOP & Notion Management : Fully own and update all CEO-related workflows and databases, ensuring documentation is audit-ready and searchable.
Small-Scope Project Management : Lead projects assigned by the Exec Ops Manager, assessing needs, developing plans, and communicating status to stakeholders.Skills & Attributes We're Looking ForMethodical & Nuanced : You understand the difference between tactical execution and strategic decision-making and can operate independently in ambiguous situations.
1–3 Years of Relevant Experience : Ideally supporting senior leaders or working in high-growth, corporate, or communications-heavy environments.
Proactive Tech-Savviness : Proficiency with Google Workspace, Slack, Hub Spot (or similar CRMs), and Notion, plus a strong drive to use AI tools for speed and efficiency.
Executive Presence : You have a professional audio/video setup and communicate with the polish required for CEO-facing interactions.
Coachability : You believe feedback is the \"breakfast of champions\" and iterate quickly based on guidance.Our ValuesCreate remarkable experiences– Every interaction is a chance to satisfy customers and internal team members.
Always be growing– Committed to continuous improvement and individual learning.
Deliver results– Taking initiative to solve problems and drive success regardless of formal responsibility.
Do the right thing– Prioritizing integrity, respect, and discretion in all interactions.
Practice what we teach– Pushing the boundaries of what it means to be AI-driven.
Compensation & LocationCompensation : Starts at $2,200 USD
Location : Remote (Working within 8 AM - 5 PM CST is preferred).Application & Selection ProcessTO APPLY:
Send your Resume(PDF titled \"Lastname. Firstname. EA.pdf\") to (Operations+ ).
Record a short demo video(2 - 4 mins max) highlighting your relevant experience for the role, skills, successes, and goals for the future. Also, we’d like you to briefly mention the following insights:Process Optimization Proposal:Share an example of how you’ve improved an operational workflow in the past (Preferably using AI or automation tools). We want you to showcase your personality, and why you believe you are the ideal candidate for the Strategic Executive Assistant role.

title: Senior product experience designer (remote) - b2b healthtech saas
description:
Ongoing contract role ·10 hours per week· Remote (Brazil Based)
Flexible hours · PST time zone overlap preferred
International team across Brazil and North America
5+ years of designing Saa S web applications(required)
Hands-on product experience design - workflows, flows, wireframes
Fluent English required - written and spokenAbout the Role
We’re looking for aSenior Product Experience Designerto help shape the user experience of a Saa S web application platform that supports healthcare practitioners in delivering better patient outcomes.This role is intentionally scoped at10 hours per week , with some overlap during PST business hours required. It’s focused onsenior-level product experience design- the kind of work where judgment, clarity, and good decisions matter.This role is well suited to someone who:
enjoys focused, high-impact work,
may already have other professional commitments,
and values collaborating with a small, international team on meaningful product problems.You’ll work closely with the founder and an experienced product, design, and development team to designend-to-end product experiences— from early concepts through to wireframes ready for visual design and implementation.This is not a UI-polish role, and it’s not advisory. You will be designing the product experience itself.About Optive
We build software that helps functional medicine and healthcare practitioners deliver better patient outcomes through clearer data, better insight, and more consistent follow-up care. Optive is the next stage of this work - a patient engagement and care platform designed to support ongoing, relationship-based healthcare rather than one-off interactions.Our team works across two closely related platforms:
Optive- a patient engagement and care platform
Optimal DX- an established diagnostics and lab interpretation system used by practitioners todayYou’ll contribute experience design work acrossboth platforms , helping ensure coherence and clarity as the ecosystem evolves.Our team is fully remote and international, working across Brazil and North America, with collaboration primarily across PST time zones - often a good fit for Brazil-based team members who prefer some evening overlap.What You'll Do
Designend-to-end user journeysfor complex Saa S web applications
Translate product goals intoclear workflows, flows, and wireframes
Think through user intent, edge cases, and complexity vs. simplicity trade-offs
Create low-fidelity wireframes and experience diagrams (Figma, Miro, etc.)
Collaborate with a senior visual designer who will take your work into high-fidelity design
Challenge assumptions constructively and improve product clarity early - before development begins
Communicate clearly with an international team inEnglish , both written and spokenWhy this Role Might be a Fit
Have5+ years of experiencedesigning customer-facing Saa S products or complex web applications
Have worked on products that real customers use in production
Are comfortable designing multi-step workflows and role-based experiences
Understand how UX decisions impact usability, adoption, and real-world outcomes
Prefer focused, senior-level contribution over full-time availability
Are comfortable working independently with a high level of trust
Can overlap some working hours with PST
Communicate fluently in EnglishPreferred Background
While we care far more about what you’ve designed and shipped than your exact job title, this role is best suited to someone who has:
Designedcomplex Saa S or web applicationsused in production
Owned or heavily influencedend-to-end product experiences , not just individual screens
Worked closely with founders, product leaders, or engineering teams in small to mid-sized software companies
Designed workflows where clarity, trust, and correctness matter (e.g. healthcare, fintech, B2 B, or data-heavy products)
Been accountable for experience decisions that had real user and business impactIf your experience is primarily marketing sites, brand work, or UI-only execution, this role is unlikely to be a fit.Proof Matters
We strongly prefer candidates who can show real work, such as:
Screenshots of shipped Saa S products
Annotated flows or wireframes
Case studies explaining experience design decisions
Clear examples of problems you personally solvedWe understand NDAs exist — but we’re looking for people who canpoint to real experience design workand talk concretely about the decisions behind it.How to Apply
Apply via Linked In.Please include:
A short note about your experience designing Saa S or web applications
Links to relevant work (portfolio, screenshots, case studies)
Anything that clearly shows how you shaped the product experience

title: Electrical bim lead
description:
At Eracore, we’re committed to developing talented engineers and exposing them to some of the most exciting electrical projects in the country, while becoming the most trusted partners in the industry. From coordination and prefabrication to detailed shop drawings, we support some of the most complex and high-stakes electrical projects in the United States, including Data Centers, Government Facilities, Manufacturing Plants, and cutting-edge Commercial developments.Under strong leadership, Eracore is quickly expanding their presence inBrazil. Our goal is to develop a team of the brightest minds to take on the biggest industry challenges on some of the coolest projects in the USA. of working with us:
Competitive Salary
Annual Bonus
Learning platforms that enable growth and development
Strong leadership and mentorshipRoles and Responsibilities
Oversee and lead the development, coordination, and delivery of Electrical BIM models across all project stages, ensuring compliance with project requirements, standards, and industry best practices.
Manage and guide the Electrical BIM team by providing technical support, quality checks, and mentorship to ensure accurate and efficient model development.
Collaborate closely with multidisciplinary teams (Mechanical, Architectural, Structural, and other engineering teams) to ensure effective model coordination and clash-free deliverables.
Conduct regular model audits, data checks, and quality control reviews to ensure the integrity and reliability of electrical BIM deliverables.
Prepare and deliver BIM-related documentation, including model execution plans, progress reports, schedules, and technical presentations.
Support the integration of BIM with other digital tools such as Navisworks, Revit and clash detection software for enhanced project delivery.
Identify process gaps and propose improvements to enhance BIM efficiency, model accuracy, and team productivity.
Train and upskill team members on BIM technologies, electrical modeling techniques, and emerging industry trends.
Coordinate with client BIM teams to understand project expectations, provide updates, and ensure smooth communication throughout the project lifecycle.Qualifications
2+ years of hands-on experience in Electrical BIM modeling, coordination, and project delivery.
Advanced proficiency in Autodesk Revit (Electrical discipline) with strong understanding of electrical systems
Strong experience using Navisworks for clash detection, coordination, and model review.
Familiarity with BIM 360, ACC, Bluebeam, and other industry tools.
Proven ability to lead, mentor, and guide juniors while maintaining high-quality output.
Ability to manage project timelines and client expectations.Preferrable
Solid understanding of U. S. construction practices, NEC codes, and electrical engineering principle.
Experience in developing BIM standards, workflows, and templates for electrical systems.
Prior experience working on Data Centers.

title: Viral video content creator
description:
Looking for aViral Video Scriptwriter + Editorwho can consistently create viral-style performance video ads using AI tools at scale. You will own the output like it’s your channel, not a “tasks” role.
We run performance marketing campaigns and need a steady pipeline of fresh, high-converting video creatives for the US consumer.Mission for this job Own the end-to-end creative pipeline for short-form video ads:
Research the market and audience
Write scripts that hook hard and hold attention
Edit fast, clean videos using AI + simple editing tools
Ship volume, learn from results, and iterate dailyWhat success looks like First 30 daysLearn our offers, compliance guardrails, and what “good” looks like for us.
Deliver a consistent daily output of scripts + edited videos (with clear naming and organization).
Build a repeatable workflow using AI tools for speed (script, voice, visuals, editing, captions).
Show you can research the US consumer and write in natural, native-sounding English.By 90 daysShip a reliable volume of creatives every week with clear variation by hook, angle, and structure.
Consistently produce multiple “winners” per month (videos we can scale spend behind).
Maintain a simple testing system: what you tried, what worked, what failed, and what to do next.
Become independent: you don’t wait for perfect direction to move.By 12 monthsFully own a creative machine that feeds our ad accounts nonstop.
Have a documented system another creator could follow.
Be the go-to person for viral ad formats, hooks, and creative strategy across offers.What you will doWrite short-form ad scripts (UGC style, narration, simple scenes, strong hooks).
Do research (audience pains, language, objections, comments, competitor ads).
Edit videos in Cap Cut (or similar) and ship finished assets ready to launch.
Use AI tools to generate footage, b-roll, voice, captions, and variations fast.
Create lots of iterations: new hooks, new openings, new pacing, new visuals.
Organize deliverables cleanly (folders, versions, naming, notes).Who you areYou have a portfolio of viral videos, ad creatives, or short-form edits.
You have strong English and can write like a real US consumer talks.
You understand basic copywriting: hook, problem, proof, offer, CTA.
You can edit quickly in Cap Cut (or similar) and keep pacing tight.
You’ve used AI tools to create videos at scale (not just one-offs).
You move fast, learn fast, and you care more about output and results than comfort.Core valuesResourcefulness– You figure things out with minimal help.
Perfectly acceptable over perfection– Ship fast, then improve.
Constructive disagreement– Challenge ideas to get to the truth.
Kind, not nice– Honest feedback that helps people win long term.
Growth mindset– Learn from misses, don’t repeat mistakes.
Full ownership– Act like the outcome is on you.Offer Competitive pay + profit share based on skill and output, with clear growth as you produce consistent winners.Apply Email

description:
Estamos em busca de umaPessoa Engenheira de Software Sênioraltamente capacitada para integrar nossa equipe e atuar como referência técnica emMachine Learning (ML), IA Generativa e Automação. Esta é uma oportunidade para profissionais que desejam ir além, moldar o futuro dos nossos produtos e desbloquear o potencial de um time remoto, autônomo e vibrante.Você chegará em um momento crucial da empresa, onde a experiência em lidar com sistemas em evolução e a capacidade de inovar em um ambiente cloud-centric (AWS) são diferenciais.Acreditamos em um senso de grupo forte e na autonomia das equipes para entregar valor.O Gran é um ecossistema que uneeducaçãoetecnologia , que acelera e customiza o aprendizado para diferentes necessidades e momentos e que já impactou mais de 2 milhões de vidas. Temos a plataforma de educação mais acessada do Brasil e fomos eleitos a 5ª empresa mais inovadora da América Latina.Hoje, temos 2 verticais principais:a de Cursos Preparatórios e a Gran Faculdade.Adotamos iniciativas tecnológicas para deixar a educação mais inclusiva. Por isso, temos atualmente vários produtos para fazer isso acontecer, como: os audiolivros – com técnicas avançadas de inteligência artificial, criamos um acervo com mais de 28 mil livros convertidos em 110 mil horas de áudio –; o Gerenciador de Estudos, que auxilia no planejamento diário; e os aplicativos para TV e celulares Android e i OS, que funcionam também no modo offline.Recursos tecnológicos e inovação nos acompanham desde sempre e, com o esforço do nosso time, fomos reconhecidos mundialmente pelaAmazon Web Servicescom três cases de sucesso envolvendoInteligência Artificial , boas práticas, inovação, inclusão e impacto.Acesse nossos cases clicando nos links abaixo:➡ 20 mil horas de vídeo legendadas com mais de 92% de precisão;
➡ Recomendação de cursos utilizando Amazon Sage Maker;
➡ Audiolivros.Se interessou? Vem serGran Lover !
Esta vaga está no nosso modelo de trabalhoGran Mundo , sendo100% remoto.
Todas as nossas vagas são no modelo de trabalho CLT.Quer saber mais sobre a gente? Clique AQUI para retornar para a página de carreiras.Responsabilidades e atribuiçõesO seu desafio como Senior AI Engineer:
Você será o pilar de engenharia da Tribo de Dados & IA. Sua missão vai muito além de codar: esperamos que você transforme protótipos de IA em produtos de software robustos, escaláveis e observáveis. Você será a referência técnica para garantir que nossas soluções (como assistentes jurídicos e sistemas de extração de dados) funcionem em produção com alta disponibilidade.Suas principais responsabilidades:
Engenharia de Sistemas de IA (AI Engineering):
Arquitetar e desenvolver o backend de aplicações baseadas em LLMs, garantindo que elas sejam rápidas, custo-eficientes e confiáveis.
Implementar pipelines de RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) de ponta a ponta, cuidando desde a ingestão e chunking inteligente de dados até a estratégia de recuperação e geração de resposta.
Criar e manter Agentes Autônomos que realizam tarefas complexas, garantindo que tenham mecanismos de controle, memória e tratamento de erros (para evitar loops infinitos ou alucinações).Liderança Técnica “Hands-on”:
Atuar como Tech Lead natural da squad: liderar definições de arquitetura, conduzir Code Reviews rigorosos (focados em design patterns e performance) e elevar a barra técnica do time.
Mentorar engenheiros plenos e juniores através de pair programming e discussões técnicas, ajudando a desbloquear problemas complexos do dia a dia.Excelência Operacional & Cloud (AWS):
Assumir a propriedade da infraestrutura das suas aplicações (“You build it, you run it”). Isso inclui saber arquitetar soluções na AWS e otimizar custos de inferência.
Garantir a observabilidade total dos sistemas: implementar logs estruturados, métricas e tracing (para debugar cadeias de Lang Chain/agentes em produção).Automação Inteligente:
Desenvolver crawlers e bots robustos para captura de dados em larga escala, integrando essas automações diretamente com nossos pipelines de IA para enriquecimento de dados em tempo real.Colaboração e Produto:
Trabalhar lado a lado com Product Managers e Designers para traduzir problemas de negócio vagos em soluções técnicas viáveis.
Ter a autonomia para questionar requisitos, propor simplificações e defender a qualidade do software contra prazos irrealistas (negociando débito técnico de forma consciente).Requisitos e qualificaçõesO que buscamos (Hard Skills & Ferramentas):
Para essa cadeira, buscamos um perfil de Engenharia de Software (Backend) com especialização em IA Generativa. Não procuramos apenas quem “consome APIs”, mas quem constrói sistemas resilientes ao redor delas.
Python Moderno & Engenharia Robusta:
Proficiência avançada em Python.
Domínio de Pydantic para validação de dados e Fast API para construção de APIs assíncronas de alto desempenho.
Experiência com gerenciamento profissional de pacotes (Poetry ou uv) e ferramentas de qualidade de código.
Arquitetura de IA Generativa & Agentes:
Experiência sólida na construção de fluxos de IA com Lang Chain e, preferencialmente, orquestração de estado com Lang Graph.
Capacidade de desenhar e implementar arquiteturas de RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) que vão além do básico: conhecimento prático de Hybrid Search (Vetorial + Keyword) e estratégias de Reranking (ex: Cohere, BGE) para garantir precisão.
Engenharia de Software & Cloud (AWS):
Mentalidade de “You build it, you run it”. Experiência provisionando e mantendo infraestrutura em AWS (ECS, Lambda, SQS).
Domínio de Docker e familiaridade com Infraestrutura como Código (Terraform ou CDK).
Design de sistemas distribuídos e orientados a eventos (Event-driven), essenciais para lidar com fluxos de agentes assíncronos.
Automação & Extração de Dados:
Experiência com frameworks de automação de browser (foco em Playwright Async) para tarefas complexas de extração de dados e interação com sistemas legados.Qualificação Necessária:
Experiência: Pelo menos 5+ anos de experiência prática em desenvolvimento de software (Backend), com os últimos anos focados ou transicionando para projetos de IA/Dados.
Formação: Bacharelado em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software ou áreas correlatas (ou experiência prática equivalente comprovada).
Metodologia: Vivência real em ambientes ágeis (Scrum/Kanban) com foco em entrega contínua.Diferenciais (O que faz seus olhos brilharem):
Se você tiver estes conhecimentos, você estará um passo à frente para liderar nossas iniciativas mais ambiciosas:
Sistemas Multi-Agentes (MAS): Experiência prática construindo sistemas onde múltiplos agentes colaboram autonomamente. Familiaridade com Google ADK ou padrões agênticos como Re Act, Plan-and-Execute e loops de auto-correção (Reflection).
RAG de Próxima Geração: Conhecimento ou interesse em Graph RAG (uso de Knowledge Graphs para capturar relacionamentos complexos) e Self-RAG (agentes que avaliam a própria recuperação).
Otimização de LLMs & SLMs:
Experiência rodando modelos locais (Phi-3, Llama-3, Gemma) para otimização de custos.
Uso de DSPy para otimização programática de prompts (substituindo a engenharia de prompt manual).
Avaliação de modelos (LLM-as-a-Judge) com frameworks como Ragas ou Deep Eval.
Ecossistema Web: Conhecimento em Node.js/Typescript ;para eventuais manutenções em interfaces ou integração com BFFs.Informações adicionais
✨ Aqui você vai encontrar benefícios como:Saúde e Bem-Estar:
Plano de Saúde e Odontológico Sul América com cobertura nacional, custeado em 100% pela empresa.

Vale Refeição ou Vale Alimentação pagos no cartão Ifood Benefícios.Reconhecimento e Incentivos:

Auxílio-Creche.Desenvolvimento Profissional:

Seguro de vida.Local de trabalho:Teletrabalho. Oportunidade de trabalhar em qualquer cidade do Brasil.Jornada de Trabalho:40h semanais. Horário flexível a combinar com sua liderança.Nós valorizamos a diversidade e todas as pessoas são bem-vindas nos nossos processos seletivos.
